name: kit-root
description: "Load before any N2/N3 work, and before reading a workflow kit path such as .agents/** or docs/workflow/**, in a repository whose adapter says the workflow kit runs as the plugin fhh. Gives the kit root, the rule that says which paths resolve under it, and the delegate names."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-plugin.mjs. Do not edit. -->

The workflow kit runs as the plugin `fhh`.

Kit root: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`. If that text shows an unexpanded variable, the kit root is the folder that contains `skills/` and `.agents/` (this skill sits in its `skills/` folder).

Path rule: a path that a kit file names is read under the kit root when that file exists there; when it does not exist there, it resolves in the repository. So `.agents/project/**`, the install state, the diagnostics, the apply journal, the seeds, `.ai-work/**` and the project's own files always resolve in the repository: the plugin ships none of them. Never write under the kit root.

Entry points: under the kit root, `.agents/instructions.md` (the contract), `.agents/skills/index.md` (the skill catalog) and `.agents/skills/00-router/workflow-router/SKILL.md` (the router); in the repository, `.agents/project/index.md` (project skills and runbooks), `.agents/project/routing.md` and `.agents/project/context.md`, read when they exist.

Delegates: In Claude Code, a delegate is the plugin agent `fhh:<slug>`, unless the project defines an agent with that slug: then the project agent wins. In Copilot, name a delegate by its alias (the `name` of its agent file); whether Copilot prefixes plugin agents is not documented. Every delegation brief carries the line `Kit root: <absolute path>`.

Next step: read `<kit root>/.agents/instructions.md`.
